design_brief.problem_statement: Принятые компоненты ещё не доказаны как единый пользовательский сценарий. Native MVP3 переносит только пустой inventory; whole-graph recovery не является actor-scoped handoff.
design_brief.current_behavior: MVP1–MVP5 verified. Diagnostic 152/0 proves expected nonempty rejection while native lifecycle and full JSON payload roundtrip pass.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Два live клиента экипируют tool, копают, получают материал once, выполняют pickup/drop/contention/container, несут непустой inventory/equipment A→B→A и строят одну Construction из canonical resources. MVP7 отдельно доказывает reconnect/restart/resync; MVP8 — связанный bounded workload. Одна примерно100-element Construction пересекает A/B seam с корректной canonical membership/ownership, continuous collision и traversal, exactly-once ADD/REMOVE, live convergence и rehydration.
alternatives_considered: Copy whole graph into live target
Native actor-scoped carrying in existing owners
design_brief.selected_design: Existing native M4 owns item staging and mutation; existing SM1 owns decisions; M3/MVP glue coordinates player/item readiness, attestation, retirement and activation. Spatial/content startup policy is server-trusted and optional; legacy defaults remain.
design_brief.why_selected: No duplicate truth or owner; unrelated players and world state remain local and untouched.
expected_risks: False product acceptance from native-only tests
validation_plan: MVP6_CROSS_AUTHORITY_CONSTRUCTION_SEAM: focused live composition, six negative controls, canonical API/data-model diagnostic if unsupported; final same frozen candidate as all existing MVP6 sub-gates
